name: Santa Caught on Camera: Santa Visits Your Home and Says a Name
blurb: Santa caught on camera is the Christmas video trend where Santa shows up on your own security camera or doorbell camera at night, looks into the lens and says a name.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: [Image 1] is the room: keep it exactly as photographed, same furniture, Christmas tree, presents, decorations, layout and camera angle, with nobody in it. Turn it into fixed colour indoor home security camera footage from a high corner, slightly desaturated, wide-angle top-down view, soft compression artifacts and light noise, a small white timestamp "12/25 03:42 AM" in the bottom-right corner. (1) A real-looking Santa Claus in a red suit and white beard walks in from the side with a large sack; (2) he crouches and puts Christmas presents under the Christmas tree one by one, among the presents already there; (3) he stands up, walks a few steps toward the camera until he is right below it, and looks straight up into the lens, his face clear and well lit by the tree lights; (4) he raises a gloved finger to his lips for "shh", smiles and says softly with natural lip movement: "Ho ho ho! Merry Christmas, {name}! {message}" Then he winks. The camera never moves, one continuous shot, vertical 9:16. Rustling paper and faint sleigh bells far away. Audio: a warm, deep, grandfatherly voice speaking the line clearly, lips in sync, with quiet room sound, no music. Santa speaks one time only, in one voice. No children anywhere: no child, no child's face, body, hand or voice, and nobody else in the house appears or answers. No people other than Santa, no brand logos, no subtitles, no other text.
